verdict.rationale: gstack is a skill/tool pack layered on host coding agents, so data-use controls are a fair axis, but there is no documentation about model training. The only related evidence is a community report that gstack collects usage telemetry and that a user can opt out of it, which would keep usage data from leaving the machine. Missing for 10: any first-party statement on whether collected data is used for AI training, a documented training opt-out or policy, first-party docs on the telemetry opt-out mechanism, and clarity on how host-agent providers handle data.
